workflow.title: Route new website leads and log assignments
workflow.goal: Read new website leads. Assign every California lead (region California or CA) to Marcus. Assign every lead with more than 200 employees to Priya, regardless of region. Assign every other non-California lead (200 or fewer employees, or missing companySize) to Priya. A California lead over 200 employees gets two log rows, one for Marcus and one for Priya. Append one lead-log row per assignment and verify the rows.

assumptions: 'send to' means record the assignment in lead-log; no outbound e-mail or chat is sent.
California is identified by region equal to 'California' or 'CA' (case-insensitive).
Leads with status 'new' are the only ones routed.
A lead over 200 employees in California gets two log rows: one for Marcus and one for Priya.
Non-California leads with a missing companySize go to Priya, since the request says 'else send to priya'.
risks: Region values spelled differently (e.g. 'Calif.') will not match and will go to Priya.
Non-California leads with a missing companySize are logged to Priya and should be reviewed.
successCriteria: Every new lead is logged to lead-log for the correct assignee.
The lead-log rows written by this run pass the independent sheet audit.
